halves_read: SERVER half: source (model, templates, datatables, classes), SQL dump (db/l1jdb_m10.sql), XML data (data/xml Cycle, Item, NpcActions), rates and config. CLIENT half not in this donor; paired client in the box is uglyoldbob-l1j-client (audit AU054), not opened by me. Audit AU029 says no pair exists; AU054 lists one; I follow AU054.

top_creatures.label: Heavy late-tier brute
top_creatures.why: The highest-level big-HP monster row in the table (level 99, HP 28,000, NPC row 81163). One large body for a late fight.
top_creatures.keep: A single heavy silhouette with a long wind-up.
top_creatures.change: Each swing telegraphs with a visible ground mark before it lands.

top_creatures.label: Gated caller
top_creatures.why: A summoner whose ordered skill list is gated by random chance, HP ratio, lowest-companion HP, distance band and use count. First usable skill wins.
top_creatures.change: A visible call-out before each summon, and the three defects fixed (section 7 of the md).

top_creatures.label: Kin-alert pack
top_creatures.why: Family tags with a mode: mode 1 alerts the same family only; a group leader links its group.
top_creatures.change: A hate list with the three-attacker cap (Frankendom ruling MAX_ATTACKERS = 3) and an alert ring on the ground.

top_creatures.label: Window boss
top_creatures.why: A world boss whose appearance is a random point inside a daily window (28 live cycle entries).
top_creatures.keep: The daily window and the random appearance.
top_creatures.change: A sighting hint and a daily jitter stored once per cycle; closed-form cycle search.

top_creatures.label: Hard-flag elite
top_creatures.why: 144 monsters carry a hard flag in data, so an elite is a data mark, not a special class.
top_creatures.keep: A flag that marks elites in data.
top_creatures.change: An elite ring that reads at 375 wide, not a stat number.

top_creatures.label: Tamable companion that evolves
top_creatures.why: 234 tamable monsters; 29 pet-type rows link each form to the next form through an evolution column.
top_creatures.change: Each evolution shows as a silhouette change with its own idle loop.

top_creatures.label: Ambush trap creature
top_creatures.why: 34 of 52 traps summon monsters when triggered.
top_creatures.keep: A trap that spawns its own threat.
top_creatures.change: A telegraph on the floor before it fires.

top_creatures.label: Light-carrying creature
top_creatures.why: 1,399 NPC rows carry a light radius as data.
top_creatures.change: Light colour per faction, readable at 375 wide.

originals.name: Gated Caller
originals.idea: An ordered skill list where each skill is gated by random chance, HP ratio, lowest-companion HP, distance band and use count; first usable skill wins.
originals.change: A visible call-out before each summon; the three defects fixed (random <=, no target mutation in a gate, summon cap falls through).

originals.name: Window Warden
originals.idea: A world boss that appears at a random point inside a daily window, with a sighting hint.
originals.keep: the daily window and the random appearance
originals.change: A per-cycle jitter stored once; closed-form cycle search.

originals.name: Kin Alarm
originals.idea: Family tags with a mode: a pack alerts its family, and a group leader links its group.
originals.change: A three-attacker cap and an alert ring on the ground.

originals.name: Weighted Strongbox
originals.idea: A treasure box with random chances that sum to 100 (60 random boxes all sum to 100; 50 fixed-content boxes).
originals.keep: the weighted table and the 100 check
originals.change: A rarity colour and sound at the moment of the drop.

originals.name: Tamer's Growing Companion
originals.idea: A tamable creature with a data link to its next form.
originals.change: Each form has its own silhouette and idle loop.

originals.name: Tower Stack
originals.idea: Dungeon floors joined by teleport rows, one theme per level.
originals.change: A palette shift per floor and a cleared-floor marker.

originals.name: Rest Ring Shrine
originals.idea: A regen multiplier for rest zones shown as a campfire glow.
